title: Production traffic reconciliation and recovery
honestConclusion: Traffic routing infrastructure still does not exist. Per prompt sections 7 and 29, every cutover attempt returns BLOCKED with NO_TRAFFIC_ROUTER_CONFIGURED. Phase 228 corrects the recovery classifier per section 17, adds the POST_ROLLBACK_HEALTH_CHECK state, adds durable previous-target capture before any traffic mutation, and adds a full conformance test suite proving every other guarantee.

sectionChanges.section5PreviousTargetCapture: DeploymentActivationService.capturePreviousTarget() resolves the current active deployment via DeploymentHistoryService.getCurrentDeployment before any TRAFFIC_CUTOVER transition, and threads it through CutoverRequest.previousContainerName and the ActivationResult.previousTarget field.
sectionChanges.section14RollbackSafety: rollback() still refuses when intent is not ACTIVE/HEALTH_DEGRADED; it does not attempt traffic revert without a valid previous target.
sectionChanges.section18Persistence: No new tables required. DeploymentHistoryService.previous_deployment_id already carries the binding.

verified: 228A kernel wiring intact (activation + intents + deployments + executor)
228D previous-target resolved BEFORE cutover via real DeploymentHistoryService

228G cutover BLOCKED -> intent=ACTIVATION_FAILED with real reason persisted
228N restart recovery: intent in ACTIVATING classified RECOVERY_REQUIRED with requiresDockerInspection=true
